title: The Mountain Range That Accidentally Froze Our Planet
description: Discover how the tectonic collision that formed the Himalayas triggered global cooling, reshaped our atmosphere, and altered the course of human evolution.
instagram_caption:
Fifty million years ago, a colossal collision built the Himalayas—and completely rewrote Earth’s climate. 🏔️ From scrubbing carbon from the atmosphere to forcing our ancestors to walk upright, this massive wall of rock controls our world.
